assignmentNote: optimal lineup by confidence-weighted shrunk role winrates, all 120 permutations scored
duoLaneNote: carry+support on the same team actually share a lane; mined from each member’s last ~150 ranked matches, 10+ duo-lane games required
triosNote: from each member's last 50 ranked matches (265 distinct matches since 2025-12-12); older trio games are outside this window — duos are all-time
notes: The lineup above is worth about +4.2 wins per 100 team games versus everyone queueing their usual role.
Willy Guggenheim moves to support: 51.1% over 344 games beats their queue habit (jungle).
Xeebs moves to jungle: 53.2% over 307 games beats their queue habit (carry).
Cuban Noobster moves to carry: 56.1% over 176 games beats their queue habit (midlane).
Mr_Meat31 moves to offlane: 53.9% over 141 games beats their queue habit (carry).
Goldilocks324 moves to midlane: 53.2% over 165 games beats their queue habit (carry).
Strongest duo: Cuban Noobster + Goldilocks324 at 56% over 225 ranked games. When only two queue, prefer this pair.
Stack synergy: queued together the stack averages 52%, against a 50% career baseline — queueing as a stack is worth real wins.
honesty: role winrates are career-wide, adjusted toward each player’s own average so thin samples don’t overclaim
pair winrates count ranked games where both were allies; they include games with randoms filling the rest
trio records come from a recent-match window, not all-time history
hero suggestions require 10+ of the player’s own games on the hero in that exact role (real 5v5s only); samples under 20 games show their count
